g.title: j252247886
g.text: babes - babes u there? lmao i need a hand with something i got a plan n i need a decoy

g.title: j701291982
g.text: this is gonna be soooo good

g.title: j3339477442
g.text: so i was just on patrol w/ lettie n eleanor n we just snagged a scaldra truck

g.title: j1935001347
g.text: fiiine i'll go get aoi, she'll help

g.title: j4059599036
g.text: i knew u n i were a thing 4 a reason

g.title: j2701273316
g.text: thing was filled with like 50,000 boxes of packing peanuts

g.title: j2514026534
g.text: u know, the biodegradable ones? basically cheese poofs without the cheese flavour

g.title: j2920167710
g.text: no clue what the fk they needed them 4

g.title: j2811729119
g.text: at 1st we were gonna just dump them in the river, or w/e but then i had a thought...

g.title: j475880909
g.text: 'naaaaah fam, i got a fkin use for theeeeese'

g.title: j1653401615
g.text: so. tomorrow. i need u 2 distract amir when he's at his computer, yeah?

g.title: j1298182806
g.text: don't care how. just keep him talking. n i'm gonna completely fill his room with fkin' packing peanuts

g.title: j3316714544
g.text: this is gonna be so good lmao

g.title: j4105964465
g.text: What if Lettie's rats get into them?

g.title: j2020449658
g.text: yeah that's the point lol. don't worry i'll help him clean it all up

g.title: j3845067698
g.text: biodegradable. n i checked with her first, she's fine with it. says they're basically rat snacks anyway

g.title: j3453288083
g.text: psh. its all in good fun. but fine, suit urself. i'll get aoi 2 help

g.title: j1173148510
g.text: now that's what i'm talking about!
